# Parley v0.1.40

Three fixes found by using v0.1.39, and one correction to what Help and the
documentation claimed. Nothing else changed.

## Moving the selected pane no longer empties the workspace

Moving the pane you had selected to another workspace left the workspace you
were looking at showing "No pane in this workspace", with the window content
collapsed to the bottom, until you clicked the workspace in the sidebar again.

The moved pane was still carrying the document's single "active" flag into the
other workspace. A move now hands that flag to one of the panes that stayed
behind, so the source workspace keeps a pane selected and the window keeps its
shape. The moved pane is drawing, with its scrollback and process intact, when
you switch to the target. The placeholders shown when a workspace has no pane,
or a pane has no surface, now fill the window instead of collapsing it.

## The Ask composer takes your typing

Opening **Ask** from the toolbar showed a black box that ignored the keyboard.
Every keystroke was going to the terminal behind it: an app-wide focus repair
handed first responder back to the selected terminal on every non-Command key,
which is right for the workbench and wrong for a text box. The repair now stays
out of the way while the composer is open or while any editable text view has
focus, which also covers text fields such as the container review's published
port. The composer asks for focus when it opens and again for each new draft.

## A finished Ask shows you the answer

When the target answered a human-initiated Ask, all you saw was a Result badge
on the pane. Status Center now opens on that exact handoff with the answer
visible. Nothing is written into the source pane's prompt; delivering the
answer onward is still your explicit Return, with its own preview.

## Help no longer describes a Stop Everything action

The in-app Help said the quit dialog offers "Keep Running, Stop Everything, or
Cancel". It offers Quit Parley or Cancel. The Stop Everything button was removed
in the native cutover on 30 August and Help, README, INSTALL, the agent
protocol text, the team approval text and the command-run trust disclosure kept
describing it. All are corrected, and Help now says how to stop things: end one
pane by exiting its CLI, closing it or restarting it (a container pane can also
be stopped from Status Center > Health > Containers); end all of them by
quitting.

## Test scenarios

`docs/test-scenarios.md` gains fail conditions for the move and composer paths,
and steps P1.2 and P2.1 no longer tell the tester to use a stop action that
does not exist.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol semantics are unchanged and the version stays at 32; the only
protocol edit removes the words "Stop Everything" from two sentences. No pane
needs restarting and no stored record changes shape.

Validated: 340 native checks, 53 Node tests, public scan, platform scan and
build. The new move check was watched failing with the controller fix reverted
and passing with it restored. The move, the composer and the Status Center
reveal were exercised by hand in the development build before this release was
cut; the workbench views have no automated coverage, so that hand check is the
evidence for them.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
